gate.conservative_warnings: Unchanged .90 flags reported and penalized; advancement requires full supported success and zero measured slipping/contact/physical failures. Legacy .6 ratio is not a static capacity; .90 flags stay reported and penalized.

selection: Admitted development training surfaces only: earliest passing time, whole-motion/resting effort; explicit frozen-parent fallback. Known stress and holdout excluded.
